It's in all of us, every clone.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''Organic chips built into our genetic code to make us do whatever someone wants, even kill the Jedi. It's all in here.|Clone troopers [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] Fives and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="TCW|Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>|audio = EvidenceIsInHere-Orders.flac}}
'''Inhibitor chips''' were biochips that were engineered into the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

The chips were originally intended by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] as a safeguard against rogue Jedi. However, after his death at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], they retooled the chip to force the Clones to slaughter the Jedi upon command. When Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this caused the inhibitor chips to forcibly brainwash the Clones into turning against the Jedi, [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|leading to the defeat and near destruction of the Jedi Order]] and rise to Palpatine's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
{{Quote|That is a structural inhibitor chip, which is ''supposed'' to prevent you from being aggressive like your source, Jango Fett. Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas instructed us to implant them during your growth cycle.|Nala Se, lying about their full purpose|<ref name="TCW|Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tup-Control-Chip.png|thumb|left|300px|Tup under the influence of his chip]]
The chips were surgically implanted into the [[Brain/Legends|brains]] of every single [[Cloning|clone]] embryo past stage three of development.<ref name="TCW|Fugitive" /> Allegedly to prevent [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from being overly independent and aggressive, their true function was intended by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] to be a safeguard against control by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|rogue Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TCW|Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> However, the covert involvement in the cloning program of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]]<ref name="TCW|The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref><ref name="TCW|Conspiracy" /><ref name="TCW|The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>&mdash;known publicly as [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku to most in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;ensured that from the very beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the chips would play an integral part of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] conspiracy to control the clones and guarantee them capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] in accordance with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

==History==
{{Quote|We modified their genetic structure to make them less independent than the original host. They are totally obedient, taking any order without question.|[[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
Sifo-Dyas was the only Jedi to know of the chips' existence. Upon his death, Tyranus, his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] and such key [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] as [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] and [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] were the only ones who knew of the chip's existence, with the former two additionally being the only ones to know of the chip's true purpose. Tyranus deceived Lama Su and Nala Se into believing that they knew the true purpose, and also had them suppress any knowledge of it. The chips were subsequently supplied by Tyranus, whose involvement remained a closely guarded secret by the Kaminoan leadership. The Kaminoans themselves apparently believed Tyranus to be a secretive member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], even though through his directives they actively kept the nature of the chips from being known by anyone else.<ref name="TCW|Conspiracy" /> Tyranus, who posed as a Jedi, deceived Lama Su and Nala Se into believing Dyas's intention and ordered them to keep the chip a secret. 

Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWcanondates|601}}</ref> the chip of the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] malfunctioned, causing [[Gender/Legends|his]] Jedi-killing protocol to activate prematurely.<ref name="TCW|The Unknown" /> Another clone nicknamed [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] ended up discovering the truth about the inhibitor chip,<ref name="TCW|Conspiracy" /><ref name="TCW|Fugitive" /> but he was framed for attempting to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine and was shot by [[Fox/Legends|one of his fellow clones]] before he could reveal it.<ref name="TCW|Orders" />

[[File:FivesOnTheLam-Fugitive.png|thumb|280px|Fives discovered the chips were inputted in all the clones since birth.]]
It was only towards the end of the Clone Wars that the Jedi learned the elusive figure they had identified as Tyranus was in fact Count Dooku. This led to the realization that the Sith had been involved in the cloning program from its inception, although they knew not to what purpose. They chose to keep this knowledge a secret from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], as they thought it would destabilize the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and undermine the war effort. Instead, they resolved to take the only path they could see available, which was to play the game they now knew to have been orchestrated by the Sith, and bring an end to the war as quickly as possible.<ref name="TCW|The Lost One" />

Not too long after betraying and orchestrating the death of Dooku, Sidious turned the [[Chosen One]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the dark side and made him his third apprentice. With Anakin, now named Darth Vader on his side, Sidious instructed the Clones to execute Order 66. The issuance of Sidious's command activated the inhibitor chips, which then brainwashed the overwhelming majority of Clones into turning on the Jedi. The Jedi found themselves being betrayed and killed by their Clone Troopers who had served under them for the past three years. The clones and Vader proceeded to kill and [[Great Jedi Purge|nearly destroy the Jedi]], with only a handful of Jedi surviving the onslaught.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Inhibitor-Chip.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of a chip]]
Inhibitor chips first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Lost Missions'']] season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' in the episode "[[Conspiracy]]," the beginning of a four episode arc written by [[Katie Lucas]].<ref name="TCW|Conspiracy" />
